messages:
Ava: hi everyone — heads up: next Friday (Jul 12) is my birthday! I'll be remote but would love to celebrate a bit. thoughts: cake in office? virtual happy hour? e-gift? :balloon:
Drew: happy early birthday! :tada: I'm in for cake if anyone's in office. what time works?
Jordan: virtual +1. could do 4pm PT for a quick 20m hang? also can chip in for gift
Tia: I can organize cake for office — @Harper can you grab? budget ~$35? :cake:
Harper: yep can pick it up. where should I leave it?
Ava: I'm remote in NY that day — ❤️ don't feel like go out of your way. maybe do an e-gift + short zoom? if people still want cake, please don't spend more than $25.
Drew: easy — poll: 1) Cake in office 2) Virtual happy hour 3) e-gift only. Reply with 1/2/3. I'll tally.
Harper: 1
Jordan: 2
Tia: 3
Drew: counts so far: 1 (Harper), 2 (Jordan), 3 (Tia). still open.
CalendarBot: Event created: "Ava's Birthday" — Fri Jul 12 4:00 PM PT — Zoom link added, invite sent to channel.
Ava: aw thanks all. If we go e-gift, PayPal.me/ava-bday or Venmo @AvaL would work. please DM me if you want to contribute and stay anonymous :blush:
Jordan: I sent $10 via Venmo. also will drop a gif in #random.
Tia: I'll cover the e-gift; DM me @Ava if you want to be included.
Drew: :balloon: ok final plan: virtual hang 4pm PT, e-gift. cake optional for folks in office — Harper will handle if people want it. adding celebration to calendar. Happy early birthday Ava! :party_parrot:
Ava: you all are the best. virtual cake accepted :slice_of_cake: see you at 4!
